description: Returns budget configuration for a company

schema.description: Company-level budget configuration for a company.

id.description: Unique string identifier for this company budget configuration record.

company_id.description: ID of the company this budget configuration belongs to. Use as the company_id path parameter in company-scoped budget requests.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this configuration was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this configuration was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

financial_periods_enabled.description: Whether financial periods are enabled for the company's budgets. Update via PATCH /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/configurable_budgeting/company_budget_configuration.
